summary: A spelling change in the primary tenant's name can exclude {apartment} from a long-term lease study.
realLife: New York City board staff required an exact primary-name match across ten registration years. They acknowledged that a typo could remove a continuing tenant from the sample.
gates: The case record identifies the registration series, matching rule and name discrepancy.
inGame: needs: registration series, matching rule and name discrepancy.

turns.what: Staff exclude the record under the published method.
The correction can inform a later analysis.
